# Rubicon Protection

> Arizona based security company with worldwide reach. Executive protection, event security, and armed or unarmed security guards for commercial and government clients. Nationwide one-call coverage for multi-location companies.

Phone: 833-217-1117
Email: info@rubiconprotection.com
Licenses: AZ DPS Security Guard Company #1732763; AZ DPS Private Investigator #1732762; WA License #1076

## Services
- [Executive Protection](https://www.rubiconprotection.com/executive-protection): close-protection details for home, business, vehicles, family and travel, worldwide.
- [Event Security](https://www.rubiconprotection.com/event-security): screening, staffing and venue control from small weddings to large amphitheaters.
- [Wedding Security](https://www.rubiconprotection.com/wedding-security): guest list check-in, security where alcohol is served, and staffing to the venue's security requirements.
- [Security Guards](https://www.rubiconprotection.com/security-guards): uniformed armed and unarmed officers for businesses and government.
- [Data Center Penetration Testing](https://www.rubiconprotection.com/data-center-penetration-testing): physical security penetration testing of data centers; Rubicon has tested dozens of facilities over 5 years and does the work itself.
- [National Accounts](https://www.rubiconprotection.com/national-accounts): one call from the company; Rubicon staffs posts across locations.
- [Jet and Yacht Rentals](https://www.rubiconprotection.com/rentals): private jet, yacht, helicopter and ground transport through partner Advent Jets.
